Applications tothe Moon and Mars will be addressed.Major critical points (material compatibility with propellant, zero boil off for cryogenic propellant,...) are aimed at being investigated and solutions proposed.This activity encompasses the following tasks:- Trade-off analyses of inflatable tank design- Prototype and test a proof of concept (for different applications and propellants for Moon and Mars scenarios)- Roadmap development plan
